farol.ideia: Elias Ward, a gray-bearded lighthouse keeper in a navy coat, hears a distress call in a storm and guides a lost fishing boat home with Mara Quinn, a young red-haired radio operator in a green sweater.
farol.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: gray-bearded lighthouse keeper in a navy coat climbing a spiral staircase at night in a storm] Elias Ward had kept the lighthouse alone for thirty years.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: young red-haired woman in a green sweater wearing headphones at an old radio set, the gray-bearded keeper in a navy coat standing behind her] That night, Mara Quinn caught a faint call on the radio.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: gray-bearded lighthouse keeper in a navy coat turning a huge lamp at the top of the lighthouse] A small fishing boat was lost in the storm.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: the gray-bearded keeper in a navy coat and the red-haired woman in a green sweater watching a small boat reach the harbor at dawn] Together, they lit its way back home.
farol.nota: leitura_simulada: a resposta bruta não é gravada; esta reproduz o gravado (lidos = os dois, aplicar = null, removidos = [])

juno.ideia: A realistic story about Juno, a golden retriever with a red bandana, who walks alone to the lighthouse every evening to wait for the fishing boats.
juno.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: golden retriever with a red bandana walking alone on a seaside path toward a lighthouse at sunset] Every single evening, Juno walked to the old lighthouse alone.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: golden retriever with a red bandana sitting on dark rocks watching the sea] She sat on the rocks and watched the water.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: golden retriever with a red bandana barking at the dark sea in thick fog] When the fog rolled in, she barked until dawn.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: small fishing boats arriving at a harbor at sunrise, golden retriever with a red bandana wagging its tail on the dock] The fishermen say her voice still brings them home.

bolt.ideia: A 3D animated cartoon about Bolt, a small round orange robot with big blue eyes, who finds a lost seed in a junkyard and grows the first flower there.
bolt.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: 3D animated cartoon, a small round orange robot with big blue eyes rolling through a gray junkyard] Bolt was the smallest robot in the whole junkyard.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: 3D animated cartoon, the small round orange robot holding a tiny glowing seed in its metal hands] One gray morning, he found a tiny seed nobody wanted.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: 3D animated cartoon, the small round orange robot watering a little green sprout between rusty cars] So he watered it every single day, rain or rust.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: 3D animated cartoon, a bright yellow flower blooming in the junkyard, the small round orange robot smiling beside it] And the junkyard grew its very first flower.

ember.ideia: A fantasy story about Ember, a small green dragon with orange wings, who cannot breathe fire until the night her mountain village freezes.
ember.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: a small green dragon with orange wings sitting on a snowy mountain ledge] Ember was the only dragon who could not breathe fire.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: a small green dragon with orange wings trying to blow fire, only a puff of smoke comes out] Every time she tried, only a little smoke came out.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: a snowy mountain village at night with dark frozen houses, nobody in sight] Then one winter night, the whole village froze.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: a small green dragon with orange wings breathing a warm stream of fire over a stone hearth, golden light on the snow] She took one deep breath, and the mountain glowed.
